Malzahar.escape: Malzahar has no ability to create distance on his own, so look for a chance to close the gap after dodging Malzahar Q Call of the Void and breaking Malzahar P Void Shift. If Malzahar can use R Nether Grasp, don't go in alone; fight when allies can interrupt the cast.
Malzahar.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Malzahar's main damage is magic, and Mel has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Malzahar R Nether Grasp deals damage based on your maximum health, so don't rely on stacking health alone.
Malzahar.combo: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Mel E Solar Snare, then continue the fight when you can land a root. Once Mel E Solar Snare's root is confirmed, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley at that spot and follow with empowered basic attacks. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if Mel P Searing Brilliance has built up enough stacks.
Malzahar.fight: If Malzahar P Void Shift is active, break it first with Mel E Solar Snare, then look for a root and focused attack while his passive is down. Manage your distance while watching for the silence from Malzahar Q Call of the Void and suppression from Malzahar R Nether Grasp. If Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons are already out, clear them first with an area ability like Mel Q Radiant Volley.
Malzahar.laning: Pressure the lane by using Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, leaving less room for Malzahar W Void Swarm to build up. Back away from minions affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions to avoid the effect transferring to you. If Malzahar pushes the lane, break Malzahar P Void Shift first and look for a chance to take him down with your jungler.
Malzahar.phase: Malzahar W Void Swarm grows stronger over time, and Mel gets stronger as she completes her core item order, so pressure early but avoid forcing fights.
Malzahar.teamfight: Stay furthest back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Mel P Searing Brilliance's stacks to several of them. If Malzahar W Void Swarm's summons are on the field, clear them first with area abilities, and keep your distance so Malzahar R Nether Grasp doesn't catch you alone. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse when enemies have lost health and several still have stacks.
Malzahar.watch: When you see Malzahar Q Call of the Void, move beyond the outer edges of the two portals to avoid the silence. If a minion affected by Malzahar E Malefic Visions dies, the effect transfers to the nearest enemy, so don't stand near that minion. Malzahar R Nether Grasp suppresses and deals damage based on your maximum health, and Mel W Rebuttal's shield won't remove it, so don't enter an area without vision alone while Malzahar can use R.

Qiyana.phase: Qiyana is strongest in the mid game, so build armor without giving her an advantage in the early and mid game. Mel gains the upper hand as she builds Overwhelm and completes her core items, so move with your allies in the late game.
Qiyana.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Qiyana’s main damage is physical, so build armor first. Since you’re facing an assassin, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your core item order.
Qiyana.combo: Before Qiyana E Audacity is back up, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow with basic attacks to build empowered projectiles and Overwhelm, then finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse when you have enough Overwhelm and the stacks are still active.
Qiyana.escape: Don’t engage just because Qiyana W Terrashape is down; wait for Qiyana E Audacity to be down too. If Qiyana has used her combo and is still in front of you, root her with Mel E Solar Snare and counterattack.
Qiyana.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley and save Mel E Solar Snare until Qiyana closes the distance to engage. If Qiyana has used both Qiyana W Terrashape and Qiyana E Audacity and is still in front of you, hit her with Mel E Solar Snare’s root to trade back.
Qiyana.laning: Stand behind the minion wave to increase the distance Qiyana must cover to engage, and move to open ground away from walls and brush. Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, but don’t use Mel E Solar Snare to poke early and lose your way to stop her engage.
Qiyana.teamfight: Stay furthest back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to multiple targets. Time Mel W Rebuttal against incoming projectiles, but don't rely on it to stop engages from Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity. Stay away from walls to avoid Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent's angle, then finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health.
Qiyana.watch: Qiyana Q Elemental Wrath / Edge of Ixtal can root you when she has the river element, so move out of range if she approaches with it. Qiyana R Supreme Display of Talent explodes on contact with terrain, so don’t stand with your back to a wall and avoid riverbanks and narrow passages. Mel W Rebuttal can’t block Qiyana W Terrashape or Qiyana E Audacity dashes.

Diana.teamfight: From the back line, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on clustered enemies to apply Overwhelm. Spread out from your allies so multiple people aren’t pulled in by Diana R Moonfall. Use vision to watch for Diana’s flank, and time Mel W Rebuttal to meet incoming Diana Q Crescent Strike. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm stacks.
Diana.build: Build magic resistance first with a Null-Magic Mantle early. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Diana.combo: After rooting Diana as she engages with Mel E Solar Snare, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow with a basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm. Look for the moment right after Diana W Pale Cascade’s shield is down.
Diana.escape: If Diana engages first with E Lunar Rush without landing Q Crescent Strike, that’s a window when her mobility spell won’t reset. Root her with Mel E Solar Snare then and counterattack. If Diana Q Crescent Strike has marked you, don’t treat it as this window; create distance instead.
Diana.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley, but save Mel E Solar Snare to stop Diana’s engage. If Diana Q Crescent Strike hits you, Diana E Lunar Rush may reset, so create distance instead of trying to catch her. Fight after the spheres and shield from Diana W Pale Cascade disappear.
Diana.laning: Don’t use Mel E Solar Snare for poke or farming first. Wait for Diana’s engage from behind the minion line.
Diana.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds Overwhelm and completes her core item order, so survive the early game and look for late-game fights.
Diana.watch: Diana Q Crescent Strike curves as it flies, so sidestep it. If it hits and marks you, Diana E Lunar Rush can go in again, so create distance. Time Mel W Rebuttal to meet incoming Diana Q Crescent Strike. Mel W Rebuttal can’t stop a dash, so don’t rely on it against Diana E Lunar Rush.

Neeko.teamfight: From the back line, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to build Overwhelm on multiple targets. If a disguised Neeko P Inherent Glamour opponent closes in, spread out without waiting for the Neeko R Pop Blossom cast animation. Use Mel W Rebuttal at the moment of her engage to benefit from its shield and movement speed. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after several enemies have lost health and have Overwhelm stacks.
Neeko.watch: Neeko E Tangle-Barbs grows and speeds up when it hits a target in front, making it easier to root Mel behind them, so don’t stand on top of your allies. Time Mel W Rebuttal to meet the incoming Neeko E Tangle-Barbs. Neeko R Pop Blossom cannot be reflected, so move out of range when Neeko engages or you see its cast animation. Neeko P Inherent Glamour hides that animation while she is disguised, so keep your distance in advance when someone you suspect is Neeko approaches.
Neeko.laning: Stand apart from your allies so Neeko E Tangle-Barbs cannot pass through multiple targets and reach you. Don’t chase the clone from Neeko W Shapesplitter. If Neeko disappears from view and an unexpected enemy approaches, suspect a disguise and keep your distance.
Neeko.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Neeko’s main magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for magic resistance and the tenacity you need against Neeko R Pop Blossom following Neeko E Tangle-Barbs.
Neeko.combo: After confirming the root at the center of Mel E Solar Snare, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot and use basic attacks. If you’ve used abilities in quick succession, don’t forget to use the empowered basic attack. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse when you’ve built enough Overwhelm and the stacks are still active.
Neeko.escape: The window while Neeko R Pop Blossom is down is your chance to apply pressure. If Neeko E Tangle-Barbs is down too, keep your distance, catch her with Mel E Solar Snare, and attack.
Neeko.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build up Overwhelm, and hit Neeko with Mel E Solar Snare to stop her engage when she closes the distance. After blocking or dodging Neeko E Tangle-Barbs, you have a chance to trade if you land Mel E Solar Snare’s root while Neeko R Pop Blossom is down. Mel has no skill to escape on her own, so don’t use Mel E Solar Snare early just to poke.
Neeko.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds Overwhelm, so make it through the early game safely and look for your opportunity in the later stages, once you have your core items.

Fizz.teamfight: Stay close to your allies and build Overwhelm on several enemies with Mel Q Radiant Volley from behind your formation. Make Fizz use E Playful / Trickster first, then focus him with your allies; don’t chase him alone. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after several enemies have taken damage and have Overwhelm stacks.
Fizz.watch: Fizz Q Urchin Strike and Fizz E Playful / Trickster are mobility spells that can get him onto Mel, so watch for the moment he closes the gap. Mel W Rebuttal can’t stop these dashes, so save Mel E Solar Snare to respond to his engage. If the fish from Fizz R Chum the Waters attaches to you, move away from your allies before the shark erupts.
Fizz.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots early. Fizz’s main damage is magic, and Mel has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Fizz.combo: After Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, land the root with the center of Mel E Solar Snare. If you’ve built enough Overwhelm, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Fizz.escape: The moment after Fizz E Playful / Trickster goes on cooldown is your chance to engage. If Mel E Solar Snare hits then, Fizz can’t use Playful / Trickster to escape. Watch for Fizz Q Urchin Strike as well, since he can use it to disengage if it’s still available.
Fizz.fight: Build Overwhelm with Mel Q Radiant Volley while keeping enough distance for Fizz to come in. If Fizz E Playful / Trickster is down, root him with Mel E Solar Snare and focus your attacks on him. If Fizz Q Urchin Strike is still available, account for that mobility spell when you engage.
Fizz.laning: Stand behind the minion line and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Save Mel E Solar Snare to stop Fizz’s engage instead of using it first for poke or farming. Look to trade when Fizz fails to secure a last hit with W Seastone Trident and the ability goes on its full cooldown.
Fizz.phase: Mel gains an advantage by surviving Fizz’s early engages and completing her core items.

Ahri.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Build magic resistance first to withstand Ahri’s main damage, but magic resistance cannot reduce the true damage from Ahri Q Orb of Deception on its return.
Ahri.combo: When Ahri’s mobility ability is down, root her with the center of Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and if you have built enough Overwhelm, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Ahri.escape: The moment after you dodge Ahri E Charm or catch it with Mel W Rebuttal is your chance to attack.
Ahri.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and use Mel E Solar Snare to stop Ahri when she closes the distance. When Ahri E Charm comes flying at you, time Mel W Rebuttal to catch the projectile.
Ahri.laning: Stand behind minions to dodge Ahri E Charm, and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Mana costs are high early, and Mel W Rebuttal has a long cooldown, so save Mel E Solar Snare for Ahri’s engage instead of using it to farm or poke.
Ahri.teamfight: Stay at the very back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to build Overwhelm on multiple targets. If Ahri E Charm flies at you, time Mel W Rebuttal to catch it, but keep your distance because Mel W Rebuttal cannot send back the dash from Ahri R Spirit Rush. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have taken damage and multiple targets have Overwhelm.
Ahri.watch: If Ahri E Charm hits you, you can easily get caught by her follow-up combo, so keep minions between you and her. Ahri Q Orb of Deception can hit you on its return, so after dodging the first pass, move out of its return path too.

Syndra.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and don’t cast Mel E Solar Snare too hastily while Syndra E Scatter the Weak is available. Once Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, close the distance, root her with Mel E Solar Snare, and continue your attacks. When Syndra W Force of Will flies toward you as a projectile, try to reflect it with Mel W Rebuttal.
Syndra.escape: Syndra E Scatter the Weak has a long cooldown and is her only self-defense tool, so the moment after she uses it is your window to engage. After moving out of the spheres’ line, close the distance and land Mel E Solar Snare; Syndra has no mobility skill, making it difficult for her to escape.
Syndra.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Syndra’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots to gain movement speed, and walk out of spots targeted by Syndra Q Dark Sphere and Syndra E Scatter the Weak. Keep your total health in mind to prepare for the true damage from Syndra W Force of Will and the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power.
Syndra.combo: After Syndra E Scatter the Weak is down, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Be sure to follow with an empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm. If Syndra has a shield, the execute threshold rises, so go for it immediately after the shield is removed.
Syndra.laning: Keep your distance behind the minion wave and save Mel E Solar Snare for when Syndra closes the distance. Get boots early so you can walk out of Syndra’s ground-targeted attacks.
Syndra.phase: Don’t force fights when you only have one core item; look toward the late game, when you’ll have built more Overwhelm and items.
Syndra.teamfight: From the very back, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to multiple targets. Avoid areas with many Syndra Q Dark Sphere spheres and the stun line from Syndra E Scatter the Weak, and time Mel W Rebuttal against incoming projectiles. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and multiple targets have Overwhelm stacks.
Syndra.watch: If Syndra Q Dark Sphere is between you and Syndra, Syndra E Scatter the Weak can push the sphere into you and stun you, so move out of its line. Move away from areas where Syndra Q Dark Sphere has placed multiple spheres, as Syndra R Unleashed Power can deal more damage there. Watch out for the execute from Syndra R Unleashed Power when your health is low.

Annie.teamfight: Watch for the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers and don’t stand on top of your allies. From behind your team, use Mel Q Radiant Volley to apply Overwhelm to multiple enemies. If Annie moves in, catch her with the Mel E Solar Snare you saved, and time Mel W Rebuttal to catch only a confirmed incoming non-targeted projectile. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have taken damage and multiple targets have Overwhelm, and keep your distance from the summoned Tibbers.
Annie.watch: When you see the white glow from Annie P Pyromania, her stun is ready, so stay out of her ability range. To avoid the area stun from Annie R Summon: Tibbers, don’t stand on top of allies when Annie is out of sight or has her stun ready.
Annie.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Annie’s damage is magic, so Mel should build magic resistance first to withstand her burst combo.
Annie.combo: If Annie’s stun is down or you hit the root from Mel E Solar Snare, confirm the root, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Always weave in an empowered basic attack after using your abilities. If you have built enough Overwhelm, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Annie.escape: The moment after Annie has used the stun from Annie P Pyromania is your chance to step forward. Annie has no mobility ability, so if Flash is down too, approach with your jungler and catch her with Mel E Solar Snare.
Annie.fight: When Annie closes the distance, root her with the Mel E Solar Snare you saved and counterattack. If Annie E Molten Shield is active, go for the execute immediately after the shield is removed or expires.
Annie.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, and look for chances when Annie steps forward to last-hit. Don’t use Mel E Solar Snare early for poke or farming; save it to stop Annie from approaching.
Annie.phase: Play safely early, keeping Mel’s mana burden and Mel W Rebuttal’s long cooldown in mind. Mel grows stronger as she builds stacks and items, so survive the early game and fight more favorably as the game goes on.

Lissandra.watch: Lissandra Q Ice Shard pierces after hitting an allied minion, so don't stand in a line with your minions. Lissandra W Ring of Frost's root and Lissandra R Frozen Tomb's stun can leave you vulnerable to consecutive damage, so keep your distance. If Lissandra uses R Frozen Tomb on herself, save your finishing attacks until her damage immunity ends.
Lissandra.laning: Keep your distance behind the minion line and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Stand at an angle to your allied minions to avoid Lissandra Q Ice Shard's piercing path. Don't use Mel E Solar Snare to farm or poke first; save it for Lissandra's approach.
Lissandra.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lissandra deals mostly magic damage and has a root and a stun, so build magic resistance and tenacity.
Lissandra.combo: After Lissandra E Glacial Path is down or Mel E Solar Snare has prevented her from moving, confirm the root and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley at that spot. Follow with basic attacks to land empowered projectiles, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have built up enough Overwhelm. If Lissandra R Frozen Tomb is available, spread out your damage until the damage immunity from her self-cast ends.
Lissandra.escape: You have a chance to trade when Lissandra uses Lissandra W Ring of Frost on the wave or misses it. Right after Lissandra E Glacial Path is also used, she has no escape, so close the gap and catch her with Mel E Solar Snare.
Lissandra.fight: Poke and build Overwhelm with Mel Q Radiant Volley, but save Mel E Solar Snare until Lissandra approaches. While Lissandra E Glacial Path is traveling, root her with the center of Mel E Solar Snare to prevent her from recasting it to move. Time Mel W Rebuttal to block Lissandra Q Ice Shard as it flies toward you.
Lissandra.phase: Mel gains an advantage as she builds stacks and items, so hold on and scale in the early game.
Lissandra.teamfight: Stay furthest back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Adjust your distance based on whether Lissandra has used E Glacial Path, and look for a chance to prevent her recast movement with Mel E Solar Snare while the claw is traveling. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have built up Overwhelm.

TwistedFate.laning: Clear the wave with Mel Q Radiant Volley from behind your minions while poking Twisted Fate too. When the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is ready, stay out of basic attack range. Don’t use Mel E Solar Snare early to poke or farm; save it for when your opponent engages.
TwistedFate.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to hold out. Twisted Fate’s damage is mostly magic and Mel’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
TwistedFate.combo: After confirming the root from Mel E Solar Snare, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow with a basic attack to fire the additional projectiles built up after using abilities. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm and the stacks are still active on Twisted Fate.
TwistedFate.escape: The moment after Twisted Fate uses the gold card from Twisted Fate W Pick a Card is also a chance to fight at close range. If you see Twisted Fate R Destiny being cast and he is in range, interrupt his teleport with Mel E Solar Snare.
TwistedFate.fight: First, build Overwhelm by using Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Use Mel E Solar Snare to go for a root after Twisted Fate closes the distance or uses his gold card. Time Mel W Rebuttal for when Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards fly toward you.
TwistedFate.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds Overwhelm and items, so once you make it through the early game, the odds improve as the game goes on.
TwistedFate.teamfight: From the very back, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to multiple targets. If Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards fly toward you, time Mel W Rebuttal to its short activation window. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and multiple targets have Overwhelm stacks.
TwistedFate.watch: If Twisted Fate W Pick a Card locks in a gold card, one basic attack will stun you, so stay outside his basic attack range. Time Mel W Rebuttal to meet Twisted Fate Q Wild Cards as they fly toward you.

Galio.combo: After confirming Galio is rooted by the center of Mel E Solar Snare as he engages, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot and land an empowered basic attack. If you have enough Overwhelm and Galio’s shield is removed or has expired, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse. Don’t start this combo while Galio charges W Shield of Durand.
Galio.build: Galio’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Galio.escape: Even if Galio E Justice Punch is down, don’t rush the chase while Galio R Hero's Entrance is still available. In particular, catch him with Mel E Solar Snare during the window when Galio W Shield of Durand’s taunt is also down, before Galio R Hero's Entrance comes back.
Galio.fight: Build Overwhelm and poke from outside Galio’s range with Mel Q Radiant Volley, and save Mel E Solar Snare to root him when he approaches. Don’t unload attacks while Galio charges W Shield of Durand; back off, then deal damage again after the charge ends. Don’t try to reflect Galio E Justice Punch or Galio R Hero's Entrance with Mel W Rebuttal.
Galio.laning: Stand behind the minion line to make Galio travel farther to reach you, and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Save Mel E Solar Snare instead of using it to farm or for light poke so you can stop Galio’s engage. After Galio uses his abilities and mana to clear the wave, push the lane to limit his opportunity to affect other lanes with Galio R Hero's Entrance.
Galio.phase: Mel gains an advantage as she builds Overwhelm and items, so get through the early game and look for late-game fights.
Galio.teamfight: From the very back, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on clustered enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. When Galio E Justice Punch or Galio R Hero's Entrance comes toward you, use Mel W Rebuttal’s shield and movement speed, but remember that it can’t reflect the dash. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm stacks.
Galio.watch: Dodge Galio E Justice Punch when you see its windup as he moves backward. When Galio charges W Shield of Durand, don’t unload your damage; get outside its taunt range. Avoid the point where the two gusts from Galio Q Winds of War overlap. Move out of the area as soon as you see the landing marker for Galio R Hero's Entrance.

Lux.teamfight: From the back, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Approach spread out from your allies so you don't all get caught by Lux E Lucent Singularity, and time Mel W Rebuttal to block incoming projectiles. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have Overwhelm.
Lux.watch: Lux Q Light Binding can lead into her follow-up abilities if it hits you, so avoid lining up with an ally and bait it into missing first. You can block it with Mel W Rebuttal as it flies toward you, but its duration is short, so don't cast it early. Leave the area where Lux E Lucent Singularity lands, and sidestep when you see the red targeting line from Lux R Final Spark.
Lux.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Lux's main damage is magic, and Mel has relatively low magic resistance, so prioritize magic resistance.
Lux.combo: Approach after Lux Q Light Binding is down and root her with the center of Mel E Solar Snare. Once the root is confirmed, follow up with Mel Q Radiant Volley and basic attacks. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm and Lux still has stacks on her.
Lux.escape: Lux has no mobility, so right after Lux Q Light Binding misses or is blocked by Mel W Rebuttal is your chance to close the gap. Don't force an engage while Lux Q Light Binding is available.
Lux.fight: Make Lux Q Light Binding miss or block it with Mel W Rebuttal, then close the gap. Lux has no mobility, so rooting her with the center of Mel E Solar Snare makes it easy to follow up with damage. If Lux hits you with an ability, don't stay within her basic attack range while marked by Illumination.
Lux.laning: Stay behind the minion line and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Save Mel E Solar Snare until you have a chance to approach Lux.
Lux.phase: Mel gets stronger as she completes her core item order, so scale with the late game in mind.

Vex.teamfight: From the backline, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to build Overwhelm on several of them. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm. Low-health allies should get out of Vex's range first so Vex R Shadow Surge can't reset with her first kill.
Vex.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vex's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Vex.combo: Wait until Vex engages and you confirm they're rooted by the center of Mel E Solar Snare, then use Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you've built enough Overwhelm. If Vex W Personal Space's shield is active, attack just after it breaks or expires.
Vex.escape: If both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are down, root Vex with Mel E Solar Snare and attack.
Vex.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and save Mel E Solar Snare until Vex closes the gap. Once both Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear and Vex W Personal Space's shield are down, root Vex with Mel E Solar Snare for a chance to take them down.
Vex.laning: Stand behind the minion wave to make Vex cover more distance to reach you, and don't waste Mel E Solar Snare on simple poke or farming.
Vex.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds Overwhelm and completes her item sequence, so look for fights after getting through the early game.
Vex.watch: If Vex P Doom 'n Gloom's fear is ready, keep your distance so Vex's basic abilities can't hit you. Vex E Looming Darkness grows larger the farther it travels, so dodge briefly to the side instead of running straight back when you're in range.

AurelionSol.teamfight: Stay in the back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to multiple targets. If Aurelion Sol engages with Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight, use the shield and movement speed from Mel W Rebuttal, but don’t expect to reflect the dash. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have taken damage and multiple targets have Overwhelm, and spread out from your allies to avoid being hit together by the upgraded Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Aurelion Sol’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health, so don’t rely on choices that only add health.
AurelionSol.combo: After Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, first confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare. Cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot and weave in basic attacks to apply extra projectiles and Overwhelm. If you have enough Overwhelm and the stacks are still active, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
AurelionSol.escape: Right after you make Aurelion Sol use Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is your chance to close the distance. Hit the center of Mel E Solar Snare to root him, making it difficult for him to escape. If Aurelion Sol still has crowd control, keep your distance because Mel has no built-in escape.
AurelionSol.fight: Start by poking with Mel Q Radiant Volley, then hit Aurelion Sol with Mel E Solar Snare when he closes the distance. Right after Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight is down, root him with Mel E Solar Snare and counterattack. Mel W Rebuttal can’t send back a dash, so don’t expect it to reflect Aurelion Sol W Astral Flight.
AurelionSol.laning: Early on, stand behind minions and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, while avoiding taking Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light for long. Don’t use Mel E Solar Snare for an early poke; save it to stop Aurelion Sol from approaching.
AurelionSol.phase: Aurelion Sol is at his weakest early, before he has Stardust, so use poke and Mel E Solar Snare afterward to hinder his scaling. In the midgame, use Mel R Golden Eclipse to join fights from range, and in the late game, watch out for his permanently stacked Stardust and upgraded Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend.
AurelionSol.watch: Aurelion Sol Q Breath of Light deals damage based on max health and builds Stardust, so stand behind minions and quickly move out of its aim line. When your health is low, also avoid the edge of Aurelion Sol E Singularity, which can put you at risk of an execute; if you get caught, move out immediately. In the late game, Aurelion Sol R Falling Star / The Skies Descend can be upgraded to knock up an area, so spread out from your allies.

Yone.teamfight: Stay with your allies without falling too far behind, and keep some distance between each other so Yone W Spirit Cleave doesn't clip several allies at once. From the backline, apply Overwhelm to several enemies with Mel Q Radiant Volley, and respond to Yone's engage with your saved Mel E Solar Snare. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm.
Yone.build: If Yone gets on top of you, Mel W Rebuttal can't stop his dash, so move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core item sequence. Yone Q Mortal Steel deals physical damage and Yone P Way of the Hunter deals magic damage, so consider both damage types instead of building only one resistance.
Yone.combo: After Yone engages, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare, then place Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse when you've built enough Overwhelm. If Yone W Spirit Cleave's shield is active, the execute threshold is higher, so attack immediately after the shield is removed.
Yone.escape: Before Yone R Fate Sealed comes back up is your chance to engage. Check that Yone E Soul Unbound is also down, and that the tornado from Yone Q Mortal Steel isn't ready, then root him with Mel E Solar Snare. If only one mobility ability is down, he can escape with the other, so wait longer.
Yone.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and save Mel E Solar Snare until Yone closes the gap. After Yone engages with E Soul Unbound, hitting him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare to root him can prevent his return.
Yone.laning: After that, use Mel Q Radiant Volley to clear the wave and poke at the same time, but keep your distance when Yone's Q Mortal Steel tornado is ready. Don't spend Mel E Solar Snare on farming or proactive poke and lose your way to stop his engage.
Yone.phase: Yone is weak before he builds attack speed, so pressure his health and CS with Mel Q Radiant Volley when he doesn't have a tornado.
Yone.watch: If Yone repeatedly uses Q Mortal Steel on minions to prepare a tornado, stay out of range until the stacks disappear. If Yone follows up with E Soul Unbound and R Fate Sealed, it's easy to get caught and keep taking hits, so don't give up your distance relying only on Mel W Rebuttal.

Akali.build: Use Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Akali’s main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance and health. Move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core build to prepare for getting caught by an assassin.
Akali.combo: Start when Akali’s mobility ability is down and you can hit the center root of Mel E Solar Snare.
Akali.escape: Check that Akali W Twilight Shroud and Akali E Shuriken Flip are down before going in. If only one mobility ability is down, she can escape with the other, so don’t rush your engage.
Akali.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and use Mel E Solar Snare to block Akali’s path when she closes the distance. Time Mel W Rebuttal to catch the shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip, but don’t activate it early expecting it to stop the follow-up dash. Don’t spend Mel E Solar Snare on poke while Akali still has her mobility abilities.
Akali.laning: Stand behind the minion line to make Akali travel farther to engage, and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. When Akali steps forward to last-hit, it’s a good time to hit her with Mel Q Radiant Volley.
Akali.teamfight: Stay at the very back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to multiple targets. When the shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip flies at you, time Mel W Rebuttal to catch it, and don’t try to use Mel W Rebuttal to stop Akali’s dash. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have taken damage and multiple targets have Overwhelm.
Akali.watch: Prioritize dodging the first shuriken from Akali E Shuriken Flip. If it hits and marks you, the second dash will follow even if you move away, so also try to block the shuriken with Mel W Rebuttal as it flies in. You cannot dodge the first dash of Akali R Perfect Execution by walking, and its second hit grows stronger based on your missing health, so stay outside her engage range when your health is low.

Akshan.build: Akshan’s main damage is physical, and Mel has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots.
Akshan.combo: Root Akshan with the center of Mel E Solar Snare when Akshan E Heroic Swing is down or as he engages. If you have built enough Overwhelm, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Akshan.escape: Right after you make Akshan use Akshan E Heroic Swing is Mel’s chance to close the distance. If you push him into an open area, he can’t hook onto terrain, so use Mel E Solar Snare then to cut off his movement path and try to root him.
Akshan.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and save Mel E Solar Snare until Akshan closes the distance. Rooting him with Mel E Solar Snare right after he uses Akshan E Heroic Swing makes it difficult for him to escape. Attacking just after the shield from Akshan P Dirty Fighting is broken or expires is a good chance to trigger the execute from Mel P Searing Brilliance.
Akshan.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, but step away from the line where Akshan Q Avengerang can hit minions and gain range. Mel has low armor early, so stand behind the minion line to make Akshan travel farther to engage, and don’t use Mel E Solar Snare to farm or initiate a poke. Place vision around the river and jungle walls to watch for Akshan roaming while camouflaged by Akshan W Going Rogue.
Akshan.teamfight: Stay in the back and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to apply Overwhelm to grouped enemies, then finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after they have taken damage. Don’t expect Mel W Rebuttal to stop Akshan E Heroic Swing; use Mel E Solar Snare to cut off his engage path. If you are marked as Akshan’s Scoundrel, don’t face him alone, and fight outside the range from which he can finish you off.
Akshan.watch: Akshan Q Avengerang’s range increases each time it hits an enemy, so don’t stand in line with minions, and dodge both its outgoing and returning paths. Time Mel W Rebuttal to catch the incoming boomerang, but it cannot stop the dash from Akshan E Heroic Swing. When your health is low and Akshan R Comeuppance marks you, move behind terrain.

Ambessa.build: Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Ambessa’s main damage is physical, so build armor first, and avoid choices that only add a lot of health because Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam deals damage based on max health.
Ambessa.combo: After Ambessa W Repudiation’s shield and windup end, hit the center root of Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and if you have enough Overwhelm, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Ambessa.escape: The window to go in is right after Ambessa has used all her abilities and spent the empowered basic attack charge from Ambessa P Drakehound's Step.
Ambessa.fight: Save Mel E Solar Snare for the moment Ambessa engages, and counterattack right after her abilities and empowered basic attack charge are spent. Mel W Rebuttal can be used for its shield and movement speed increase, but don’t rely on it to stop Ambessa’s dash or Ambessa R Public Execution.
Ambessa.laning: Stand behind the minion line to make Ambessa travel farther to approach, and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Save Mel E Solar Snare, since using it to poke first removes your way to stop Ambessa’s engage.
Ambessa.phase: Ambessa is strong in the midgame as she builds core items, so be careful about direct fights during that stretch. Mel gains an advantage as she builds Overwhelm and items, so scale toward late-game fights.
Ambessa.teamfight: Stay in the back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to multiple targets. Reposition so you’re not at the end of the line from Ambessa R Public Execution, and don’t try to use Mel W Rebuttal to stop Ambessa’s dash. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have taken damage and multiple targets have Overwhelm.
Ambessa.watch: When you see the shield and windup from Ambessa W Repudiation, stop attacking and leave its range. If Ambessa E Lacerate hits you, you lose time to dodge the blade tips of the follow-up Ambessa Q Cunning Sweep / Sundering Slam, so adjust your distance immediately.

Anivia.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first to withstand Anivia’s magic damage early. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Anivia.combo: When you have a chance to catch Anivia, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and if you have enough Overwhelm before it expires, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Anivia.escape: After Anivia Q Flash Frost is down, you have a chance to close the distance and hit Mel E Solar Snare. If Anivia W Crystallize is down too, there’s less risk of a wall blocking your escape. It’s a good time to go for the kill after Anivia P Rebirth has already triggered.
Anivia.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and use Mel E Solar Snare to stop Anivia when she closes the distance. If Anivia P Rebirth is still available, go in with an ally who can destroy the egg.
Anivia.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to clear waves and poke at the same time, but save Mel E Solar Snare for when Anivia closes the distance.
Anivia.phase: Mel is weak early because of her mana costs and Mel W Rebuttal’s long cooldown, so play safely and survive.
Anivia.teamfight: Fight in a wide lane instead of a narrow jungle path where Anivia W Crystallize can easily block your escape, and save Flash in case a wall separates you from your allies. Stay in the back and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to apply Overwhelm to multiple enemies, and time Mel W Rebuttal to catch Anivia Q Flash Frost as it flies toward you. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after multiple enemies have taken damage and have Overwhelm.
Anivia.watch: Anivia Q Flash Frost can explode and stun while it’s still in flight, so stay out of range and block it with Mel W Rebuttal as it flies toward you. If you’re hit by Q or chilled inside Anivia R Glacial Storm, Anivia E Frostbite deals more damage, so leave the storm immediately. In narrow paths, Anivia W Crystallize can block your escape route.

Aurora.build: Aurora’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. Buy Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots. If healing from Aurora P Spirit Abjuration keeps pushing back your execute threshold, use Morellonomicon to reduce healing.
Aurora.combo: After confirming that the center of Mel E Solar Snare has hit and rooted the target, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and if you have built enough Overwhelm, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Aurora.escape: When Aurora has used Aurora W Across the Veil and E The Weirding to engage or escape, and Aurora R Between Worlds is also down, you have a chance to catch her with Mel E Solar Snare. If Aurora Q Twofold Hex marks you, leave its line before it returns, and if your health is low, back off instead of continuing the fight.
Aurora.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and save Mel E Solar Snare for when Aurora closes the distance. If Aurora W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, or R Between Worlds is still available, don’t follow her in just because she used one of them. In particular, fight when Aurora R Between Worlds is still on cooldown and her other mobility abilities are also down, landing the center of Mel E Solar Snare.
Aurora.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, but play safely early because of the mana cost and Mel W Rebuttal’s long cooldown. Stand behind the minion line to make Aurora travel farther to engage, and don’t use Mel E Solar Snare to farm or for a rushed poke. If Aurora hides with Aurora W Across the Veil, don’t rush your ability; watch where she’ll reappear and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley there.
Aurora.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds Overwhelm and gains more of an advantage as she completes her core item build, so get through the early game and look for late-game fights.
Aurora.teamfight: Stay in the back and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to apply Overwhelm to grouped enemies, then cast Mel R Golden Eclipse after multiple enemies have taken damage. Aurora W Across the Veil, E The Weirding, and R Between Worlds can’t be stopped by Mel W Rebuttal, so keep your distance and use Mel E Solar Snare to cut off her path. If Aurora jumps in but doesn’t participate in a takedown, catch her while her mobility is down.
Aurora.watch: If Aurora Q Twofold Hex hits you, it deals damage again on the return, so after the curse marks you, move out of the line between Aurora and yourself. The lower your health, the more damage the return deals, so back off if your health is in a risky spot. Decide whether to leave before Aurora R Between Worlds appears, and watch out for the slow when you try to leave after the zone appears.

Azir.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle first. Azir’s main damage is magic, so build magic resistance, and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Azir.combo: After Azir E Shifting Sands is down, land the root with the center of Mel E Solar Snare. If you’ve built enough Overwhelm, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse before the stacks expire.
Azir.escape: The window to engage opens right after you make Azir use E Shifting Sands. Root him with Mel E Solar Snare then to prevent his escape. If Azir places a soldier near a wall, he can use E Shifting Sands toward it, so position with his escape route in mind.
Azir.fight: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time while building Overwhelm. Save Mel E Solar Snare for when Azir closes the gap or after he uses E Shifting Sands. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves his soldiers, if they stop in place, avoid their line and angle toward Azir himself. Deal your damage during the brief window when your root lands instead of trading for too long.
Azir.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to clear the wave and poke, and don’t use Mel E Solar Snare to farm.
Azir.phase: Azir also gets stronger as the game goes on, but Mel gains an advantage by surviving the early game and building growth stacks and items.
Azir.teamfight: From the back line, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on clustered enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. When Azir uses E Shifting Sands to get on you, respond with Mel W Rebuttal’s shield and movement speed. Keep Azir R Emperor's Divide in mind and don’t enter a narrow passage as a group. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm stacks.
Azir.watch: Stay out of the straight line formed by Azir W Arise! sand soldiers. After Azir Q Conquering Sands moves them, reposition at a safe distance. If Azir uses E Shifting Sands to engage, respond with Mel W Rebuttal’s shield and movement speed, but don’t try to reflect the dash itself. Avoid engaging in narrow passages, where Azir R Emperor's Divide can knock back multiple allies at once.

Cassiopeia.build: Cassiopeia’s main damage is magic, and Mel has relatively low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Cassiopeia E Twin Fang’s healing keeps shifting the execute threshold, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Cassiopeia.combo: After confirming Cassiopeia is rooted by the center of Mel E Solar Snare, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow with Mel’s empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you’ve built enough Overwhelm. Cassiopeia E Twin Fang’s healing can change the execute threshold, so watch her remaining health to time your finisher.
Cassiopeia.escape: Cassiopeia has no mobility spell, so the moment after she uses W Miasma elsewhere is your chance to close the gap. Look to root her first with Mel E Solar Snare, and turn away when you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze to avoid the stun.
Cassiopeia.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley while building Overwhelm, and look to root Cassiopeia with Mel E Solar Snare when she closes the gap. If Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast hits you, don’t keep fighting; trade again after the poison wears off. Right after Cassiopeia uses W Miasma elsewhere, look for a chance to bind her movement path with Mel E Solar Snare.
Cassiopeia.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to clear the wave and poke at the same time, but save Mel E Solar Snare for when Cassiopeia approaches.
Cassiopeia.teamfight: From the back line, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on clustered enemies to build Overwhelm on several of them. Turn away when you see Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze’s cast animation so you don’t face it head-on. After Cassiopeia uses W Miasma elsewhere, look for a chance to catch her with Mel E Solar Snare. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and built up Overwhelm stacks.
Cassiopeia.watch: If you’re hit by Cassiopeia Q Noxious Blast, create distance until the poison wears off. While poisoned, Cassiopeia E Twin Fang deals more damage and heals more. When you see the cast animation for Cassiopeia R Petrifying Gaze, turn away to avoid the stun.

Corki.build: Survive the early game with Cloth Armor, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Corki’s main damage is physical, so build armor first, but keep in mind that resistance cannot block the true damage from Corki P Hextech Munitions.
Corki.combo: After Corki W Valkyrie is down, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow with an empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm. If Corki has a shield, attack as soon as it is removed or expires to go for the execute.
Corki.escape: The moment after Corki uses W Valkyrie is your chance to engage. With his mobility spell unavailable, Corki will have a hard time escaping if you root him with Mel E Solar Snare.
Corki.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley and build Overwhelm, but save Mel E Solar Snare until Corki closes the gap. When Corki W Valkyrie is down, hit him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare to root him, then attack. Don’t use Mel W Rebuttal on Corki W Valkyrie; save it for incoming Corki R Missile Barrage.
Corki.laning: After that, use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, pressuring Corki so he can’t farm comfortably. Don’t use Mel E Solar Snare to farm or poke first and lose your way to stop Corki from approaching.
Corki.phase: Both champions scale, but Mel gains an advantage as the game goes on by surviving the early game and building Overwhelm.
Corki.teamfight: From the back line, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on clustered enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Time Mel W Rebuttal to meet incoming Corki R Missile Barrage, and keep your distance since it can’t reflect Corki W Valkyrie. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm stacks.
Corki.watch: Corki R Missile Barrage also damages enemies around the first target it hits, so don’t hide behind minions; get out of its range. Reposition to avoid being hit by the third missile in a row, and time Mel W Rebuttal to meet incoming missiles. Corki E Gatling Gun reduces your armor and magic resistance if you’re hit, so move to the side instead of staying in front of him.

Ekko.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Ekko’s main damage is magic, and Mel has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Ekko.combo: Right after Ekko E Phase Dive gets him on you, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow with a basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse when you’ve built enough Overwhelm. If Ekko W Parallel Convergence gives him a shield, look for the moment right after it is removed or expires.
Ekko.escape: Start the main fight when both Ekko W Parallel Convergence and Ekko R Chronobreak are down. In particular, if you root him with Mel E Solar Snare before Ekko R Chronobreak comes back, he’ll have a hard time escaping. Don’t chase right away just because Ekko E Phase Dive is down.
Ekko.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley and build Overwhelm, but save Mel E Solar Snare to stop Ekko’s engage. Right after Ekko E Phase Dive gets him on you, hit him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare to root him and counterattack.
Ekko.laning: Stand behind the minion line to make Ekko travel farther to reach you. Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, but don’t use Mel E Solar Snare for poke first.
Ekko.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds up, so she gains an advantage by getting through the early game and completing her items.
Ekko.teamfight: From the very back, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on clustered enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. If Ekko E Phase Dive gets him on you, look to root him with Mel E Solar Snare, and time Mel W Rebuttal for incoming projectiles. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm stacks.
Ekko.watch: When you see the signal for Ekko W Parallel Convergence, leave the marked area to avoid the stun and shield. Move out of the return path of Ekko Q Timewinder, and use Mel W Rebuttal as it flies toward you. If you see Ekko’s afterimage, his R Chronobreak is ready, so don’t chase recklessly even if health is low.

Hwei.build: Survive the early game with a Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. Hwei’s damage is mostly magic, so build magic resistance first. Hwei Q Subject: Disaster scales with your maximum health, so avoid choices that only greatly increase your health.
Hwei.combo: After Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, root him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare.
Hwei.escape: Hwei has no spell to create distance on his own, so the moment after he uses E Subject: Torment is your chance to go in. Close the gap then and catch him with Mel E Solar Snare. Don’t go in first while Hwei E Subject: Torment is still available, since its root or forced movement can stop your engage.
Hwei.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley while building Overwhelm, and use Mel E Solar Snare to stop Hwei if he closes the gap. If Hwei E Subject: Torment is down, close the gap and look to root him. Time Mel W Rebuttal for the moment Hwei’s untargeted projectile is flying toward you.
Hwei.laning: Stand behind the minion line and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Save Mel E Solar Snare for when Hwei approaches instead of using it ahead of time for poke or farming. If Hwei lands his first spell, reposition immediately to break his combo.
Hwei.phase: Mel gains an advantage as she completes her core items and builds Overwhelm, so get through the early game safely.
Hwei.teamfight: From the very back, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on clustered enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Avoid corridors covered by Hwei’s ground effects, and look for an engage after Hwei E Subject: Torment is down. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm stacks.
Hwei.watch: If you’re caught by the root or forced movement from Hwei E Subject: Torment, you’re likely to take follow-up damage too. If the first spell hits, move immediately to avoid the second spell and the explosion from Hwei P Signature of the Visionary. Go around corridors where Hwei has placed ground effects or eyes.

Irelia.build: Buy Cloth Armor first in the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for your boots. Irelia deals mostly physical damage, and Mel has low armor, so build armor first.
Irelia.combo: When Irelia Q Bladesurge is down or Irelia engages, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley at that spot. Follow with empowered basic attacks, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have built up enough Overwhelm. Irelia can heal with Q Bladesurge, which can move the execute threshold farther away, so check your timing before finishing her.
Irelia.escape: Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge and Irelia E Flawless Duet are down is your chance to close the gap and catch her with Mel E Solar Snare. If both abilities are available, save Mel E Solar Snare and keep your distance.
Irelia.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley, but save Mel E Solar Snare for Irelia's engage. Right after Irelia Q Bladesurge is down, aim to root her with the center of Mel E Solar Snare. When Irelia closes in with Q, don't stand and fight her relying only on Mel W Rebuttal.
Irelia.laning: Keep your distance behind the minion line, and step back if a low-health minion becomes Irelia's path to engage. Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, but don't use Mel E Solar Snare to farm.
Irelia.phase: In the mid game, Mel is weak with only one core item, so farm safely. Mel gets stronger as she builds Overwhelm and completes her core item order, so survive the early game and look for late-game fights.
Irelia.teamfight: Stay at the very back and build Overwhelm on grouped enemies with Mel Q Radiant Volley, while prioritizing caution against Irelia's engage. Irelia's dash cannot be stopped by Mel W Rebuttal, so cut off her path with Mel E Solar Snare and focus her down. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after several enemies have Overwhelm and have lost health, rather than immediately after the fight starts.
Irelia.watch: Irelia Q Bladesurge can chain through low-health minions to close the gap, so step back if a half-health minion is between you. Watch for Irelia E Flawless Duet's stun, and if you are trapped by Irelia R Vanguard's Edge, wait until the blades disappear. Mel W Rebuttal blocks projectiles but cannot stop Irelia Q Bladesurge's dash.

Karma.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle early to withstand Karma's magic damage, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. If Karma's healing makes it difficult to reach Mel P Searing Brilliance's execute threshold, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Karma.combo: Confirm the root with the center of Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley at that spot and weave in basic attacks. After the shield from Karma E Inspire or Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire disappears, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if Mel P Searing Brilliance has built up enough Overwhelm.
Karma.escape: After Karma W Focused Resolve is down is your chance to close the gap and catch her with Mel E Solar Snare. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, back away and break the tether before the root applies. Mel W Rebuttal's movement speed bonus can also help you create distance.
Karma.fight: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, but save Mel E Solar Snare for when Karma closes the gap. Once Karma W Focused Resolve is down and the shield from Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire expires, catch her with Mel E Solar Snare and focus your damage.
Karma.laning: In the early game, keep your distance behind the minion line, and don't let Karma hit you with free abilities and frequently use R Mantra through Karma P Gathering Fire. Clear waves and poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley, and look for opportunities when Karma steps up to last-hit. If you use Mel E Solar Snare to farm or for light poke, it becomes harder to stop Karma from approaching.
Karma.phase: Mel gets stronger as she completes core items, so survive the early game and use your growing power later.
Karma.teamfight: Stay at the very back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Don't engage first while Karma W Focused Resolve is available, and if Karma R Mantra-empowered E Inspire has applied a shield, wait for it to end. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have built up Overwhelm.
Karma.watch: Karma Q Inner Flame applies an area slow, and the empowered Q leaves an area that detonates again after a short delay. Time Mel W Rebuttal to block the incoming projectile, and if it hits you, immediately leave the area. If Karma W Focused Resolve tethers you, create distance and break the tether before the root applies.

Kassadin.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. Kassadin's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first.
Kassadin.combo: When Kassadin R Riftwalk is down or right after he engages, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley at that spot. After using your abilities, follow up with empowered basic attacks, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have built up enough Overwhelm. Look for the moment right after Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield disappears to lower the execute threshold.
Kassadin.escape: Root him with Mel E Solar Snare then, and Kassadin will have difficulty escaping since he has no mobility besides his ultimate.
Kassadin.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley while Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield is down.
Kassadin.laning: Using unnecessary abilities near Kassadin reduces Kassadin E Force Pulse's cooldown, so clear waves from out of range whenever possible.
Kassadin.phase: Mel's Overwhelm gets stronger in the late game, but Kassadin's backline engage is dangerous, so don't stand alone.
Kassadin.teamfight: From the backline, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Mel W Rebuttal won't stop Kassadin R Riftwalk's engage, so look for a root with Mel E Solar Snare and keep your distance. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have Overwhelm.
Kassadin.watch: Kassadin Q Null Sphere's shield absorbs Mel's magic poke, so attack after the shield is down. Mel W Rebuttal cannot stop engages like Kassadin R Riftwalk, so save Mel E Solar Snare.

Leblanc.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, and choose Mercury's Treads for your boots. LeBlanc's main damage is magic, so prioritize magic resistance.
Leblanc.combo: Confirm that LeBlanc is rooted by the center of Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley at that spot. Follow your abilities with empowered basic attacks, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm stacks. If LeBlanc has created a clone, identify which one is attacking before using your combo.
Leblanc.escape: Right after LeBlanc W Distortion is down is your window to engage. Catch her with Mel E Solar Snare if her window to return to her original position has expired or she has already used her return. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains is also down, you can close the gap without worrying about being rooted.
Leblanc.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley while saving Mel E Solar Snare for LeBlanc's engage. Right after LeBlanc W Distortion, you have a chance to close the gap, but she can still return to her original position for a while, so aim the center of Mel E Solar Snare after the return window expires or she has used her return. Mel W Rebuttal cannot reverse LeBlanc W Distortion's dash, so don't give up your distance relying on it alone.
Leblanc.laning: Stay behind the minion line and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Save Mel E Solar Snare, since using it to poke first makes it harder to stop LeBlanc's engage. If LeBlanc pushes the lane and disappears from vision, alert your team immediately.
Leblanc.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds stacks and core items, so avoid forcing early fights and look to scale into the late game.
Leblanc.teamfight: Stay at the very back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. If LeBlanc W Distortion comes toward you, use Mel W Rebuttal's shield and movement speed, but remember that it won't reflect the dash. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have Overwhelm.
Leblanc.watch: If LeBlanc Q Sigil of Malice marks you, her next ability deals more damage, so don't step forward; back away until the mark disappears. If LeBlanc E Ethereal Chains hits you, move beyond the chain's range before it roots you. If LeBlanc has lost health and creates a clone, don't rush your abilities; identify which one is actually attacking.

Naafiri.build: Naafiri deals mostly physical damage, so build Cloth Armor first and choose Plated Steelcaps. Since Naafiri is an assassin, prioritize Zhonya's Hourglass in your item order. If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers and Naafiri E Eviscerate healing keeps delaying the execute, reduce her healing with Morellonomicon.
Naafiri.combo: Aim the center of Mel E Solar Snare at Naafiri as she engages and confirm the root, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley at that spot. After using your abilities in a burst, follow with empowered basic attacks, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if Mel P Searing Brilliance has built up enough Overwhelm. If Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit's shield or healing has raised the execute threshold, don't try to finish her immediately; look for another chance to attack.
Naafiri.escape: Don't go in just because Naafiri has used one Q Darkin Daggers. Wait until Naafiri E Eviscerate and Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit are also spent and she has fewer ways to move, then root and attack her with Mel E Solar Snare. In particular, the period before Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit comes back up is a favorable window.
Naafiri.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley while saving Mel E Solar Snare until Naafiri closes the gap. If you root her with Mel E Solar Snare during the window when Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit has also been spent, she has fewer ways to escape.
Naafiri.laning: Farm and poke from behind the minion line, and stay out of the range from which Naafiri can close in with E Eviscerate. If Naafiri steps between minions to last-hit, attack her along with the wave using Mel Q Radiant Volley. Don't use Mel E Solar Snare to farm or poke first; save it to stop her engage.
Naafiri.phase: In the mid game, watch for Naafiri's roams and ambushes, and establish vision broadly. In the late game, Mel's growth stacks build up and area damage clears Naafiri's pack, making grouped fights favorable.
Naafiri.teamfight: Stay furthest back and use Mel Q Radiant Volley to hit grouped enemies and Naafiri P We Are More at the same time, building Overwhelm on several enemies. If Naafiri dashes toward Mel, cut off her path with Mel E Solar Snare; don't use Mel W Rebuttal to try to stop the dash itself. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have Overwhelm.
Naafiri.watch: If Naafiri Q Darkin Daggers hits you once, create distance until the bleed ends so you don't get hit by the second attack and her pack at the same time. Naafiri R Hounds' Pursuit targets and dashes to a target, making it especially dangerous when you're alone; Mel W Rebuttal cannot stop the dash itself. While Naafiri W The Call of the Pack is active, she can't be targeted, so wait for it to end before trying to finish her.

Orianna.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Orianna’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Orianna.combo: When you have a clear chance to take down Orianna, root her at the center of Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you’ve built enough Overwhelm.
Orianna.escape: Close the distance while Orianna R Command: Shockwave is down and the ball is far away. Orianna has no skill to create distance herself, so you can keep her there by rooting her with Mel E Solar Snare.
Orianna.fight: Trade right after Orianna Q Command: Attack sends the ball away from her, when Orianna E Command: Protect’s passive defensive bonuses are absent. Watch the ball and the range of Orianna R Command: Shockwave while building Overwhelm with Mel Q Radiant Volley. When you get a chance to close the distance, root her at the center of Mel E Solar Snare.
Orianna.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, and look for the moment Orianna stays in place to last-hit. Don’t use Mel E Solar Snare to poke early; save it for when Orianna closes the distance.
Orianna.phase: After making it through the early game, Mel gains more of an advantage as she builds Overwhelm and items.
Orianna.teamfight: Watch the ball’s position rather than Orianna herself, and stand where Orianna R Command: Shockwave can’t pull in multiple allies. From the back line, apply Overwhelm to grouped enemies with Mel Q Radiant Volley. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and multiple targets have Overwhelm stacks.
Orianna.watch: Watch where the ball is with Orianna Q Command: Attack, and move away from its vicinity so Orianna R Command: Shockwave can’t pull you in. Watch out for the slow from Orianna W Command: Dissonance as well, and don’t let Orianna P Clockwork Windup’s empowered consecutive basic attacks hit you early on.

Ryze.build: Ryze’s main damage is magic, and Mel’s magic resistance is relatively low, so build magic resistance first. In the early game, hold out with Null-Magic Mantle and choose Mercury’s Treads for boots.
Ryze.combo: After confirming that Ryze has been rooted by the center of Mel E Solar Snare, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow with an empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm and the mark is still active. If Ryze has a shield, go for the execute immediately after the shield is removed or expires.
Ryze.escape: You’ll also have a window to approach after Ryze E Spell Flux or Ryze W Rune Prison is down. You must hit the center of Mel E Solar Snare to root him, so confirm it landed before following up with attacks.
Ryze.fight: Build Overwhelm with Mel Q Radiant Volley while keeping your distance, and hit Ryze with Mel E Solar Snare when he closes in. If Ryze E Spell Flux misses, the following Ryze W Rune Prison only slows you, making it a good time to trade. Time Mel W Rebuttal for when you need its shield; don’t use it early.
Ryze.laning: After that, use Mel Q Radiant Volley to clear waves and poke at the same time, and pressure Ryze's growth before items are completed. Don't use Mel E Solar Snare to poke or farm; save it for when Ryze approaches.
Ryze.phase: Look to the late game, as Mel grows stronger with more Overwhelm and gains the upper hand as she completes her core item order.
Ryze.teamfight: Stay furthest back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to multiple targets. If you're marked by Ryze E Spell Flux, move away from your allies. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, look for a chance to interrupt Ryze with Mel E Solar Snare before it activates. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and multiple targets have Overwhelm stacks.
Ryze.watch: If you’re hit by Ryze E Spell Flux, move away from your allies until the mark disappears. After the mark is applied, Ryze W Rune Prison becomes a root and Ryze Q Overload deals more damage, so prioritize dodging Ryze E Spell Flux. If you see Ryze R Realm Warp, you can interrupt Ryze with Mel E Solar Snare’s root before it activates.

Sylas.build: Buy Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Sylas’s magic damage. Choose Mercury’s Treads for boots. If Sylas W Kingslayer’s healing keeps raising the execute threshold, reduce his healing with Morellonomicon.
Sylas.combo: When Sylas engages, confirm the root from Mel E Solar Snare, then cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow with basic attacks to use the additional projectiles you’ve built up, and use Mel R Golden Eclipse when you’ve built enough Overwhelm. If you expect Sylas W Kingslayer to heal him, don’t delay finishing him.
Sylas.escape: In particular, if you land Mel E Solar Snare before Sylas E Abscond / Abduct is back up, it’s hard for him to escape. If Sylas W Kingslayer is still available, he can use it to escape too, so don’t force an engage just because one mobility skill is down.
Sylas.fight: Build Overwhelm first with Mel Q Radiant Volley and keep your distance. Save Mel E Solar Snare until Sylas approaches, then hit his engage location to root him. Sylas W Kingslayer’s dash can’t be blocked by Mel W Rebuttal, so keep your distance.
Sylas.laning: Stand behind the minion wave to increase the distance Sylas must cover to engage.
Sylas.phase: Mel gets stronger as she completes core items, so survive the early game and look for your opportunity once you’ve grown stronger.
Sylas.teamfight: Stay furthest back and cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to multiple targets. If Sylas engages on Mel, root him with Mel E Solar Snare to create a chance to focus him before he can heal with Sylas W Kingslayer. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and multiple targets have Overwhelm stacks.
Sylas.watch: With Sylas E Abscond / Abduct, the chains that fly after the first dash are more dangerous. Time Mel W Rebuttal against the incoming chains, and immediately move away from the crossing point of Sylas Q Chain Lash. Sylas W Kingslayer dashes and restores more health the more health he has lost, so don't delay finishing him for long after lowering his health.

Talon.build: Use Cloth Armor early to withstand Talon’s physical damage, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. Since you’re at high risk of being caught by the assassin Talon, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your core item order too. Talon’s high magic resistance can easily blunt Mel’s magic damage, so include penetration in your build.
Talon.combo: If Talon engages and is rooted at the center of Mel E Solar Snare, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, then finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse when you have enough Overwhelm and the stacks are still active.
Talon.escape: Immediately after you force Talon to use Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy is a chance to catch him with Mel E Solar Snare. Counterattack more aggressively if Talon has also used Talon E Assassin’s Path for movement or you confirm Talon R Shadow Assault has already been used. Don’t chase too far while Talon R Shadow Assault is still available.
Talon.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley, then use Mel E Solar Snare to cut off Talon’s approach when he closes the distance. When the blades from Talon W Rake fly toward you, you can meet them with Mel W Rebuttal, but don’t use it early to try to block Talon’s dash. If you confirm that Talon R Shadow Assault has already been used, look to counterattack; if it’s still available, don’t chase recklessly.
Talon.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to clear waves and poke at the same time, but save Mel E Solar Snare in case Talon engages. Share position information and keep vision on jungle routes to prepare for Talon’s fast roams.
Talon.phase: Mel gains the upper hand as she builds stacks and items, while Talon’s influence wanes in the late game, so let the game go long.
Talon.teamfight: From the very back, build Overwhelm on multiple enemies with Mel Q Radiant Volley. If Talon gets into your back line, group with your team and root him with Mel E Solar Snare. Time Mel W Rebuttal against the blades from Talon W Rake when they fly toward you. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and multiple targets have Overwhelm stacks.
Talon.watch: If Talon W Rake hits you both on the way out and on its return, the Talon P Blade’s End combo becomes dangerous. If you’re hit by the first strike, move out of the returning blades’ path right away. Mel W Rebuttal can’t block the dashes from Talon Q Noxian Diplomacy or Talon E Assassin’s Path.

Veigar.build: Build magic resistance first to prepare for Veigar's main damage. Buy a Null-Magic Mantle early and choose Mercury's Treads for boots.
Veigar.combo: When Veigar E Event Horizon is down, root him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare, then place Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm. Wait until the root is confirmed before using Q so it's easier to hit the follow-up explosion too.
Veigar.escape: The moment Veigar E Event Horizon goes down is your chance to close the gap. Veigar has no skill to create distance, so approach and root him with Mel E Solar Snare. If Veigar E Event Horizon has already trapped you, don't force your way through the edge; move around inside and watch for an opportunity.
Veigar.fight: Start by poking with Mel Q Radiant Volley and save Mel E Solar Snare. Time Mel W Rebuttal for when Veigar Q Baleful Strike's projectile is flying toward you, and move to dodge Veigar W Dark Matter on the ground. Once Veigar E Event Horizon is down, close the gap and hit with the center of Mel E Solar Snare.
Veigar.laning: Veigar has low armor and no mobility early, so pressure him by using Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time. Position so minions are the first two targets hit by Veigar Q Baleful Strike to avoid unnecessary hits. Don't spend Mel E Solar Snare on poke; save it for when Veigar closes the gap.
Veigar.teamfight: From the very back, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to build Overwhelm on several of them. Check the position and cast status of Veigar E Event Horizon, and move out of the marked landing spot for Veigar W Dark Matter. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have Overwhelm.
Veigar.watch: Even if Veigar traps you with Veigar E Event Horizon, you won't be stunned if you don't cross the edge, so move around inside and wait for it to disappear. Veigar W Dark Matter's landing spot is shown in advance, so keep moving to dodge it. If your health drops below half, get out of range of Veigar R Primordial Burst, which deals more damage based on your missing health.

Viktor.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Viktor's main damage is magic, and Mel has low magic resistance, so build magic resistance first.
Viktor.combo: Outside Viktor W Gravity Field, confirm the center root from Mel E Solar Snare, then place Mel Q Radiant Volley on that spot. Always weave in an empowered basic attack after using your abilities. If Mel P Searing Brilliance's Overwhelm is sufficient and Viktor Q Siphon Power's shield is gone, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse.
Viktor.escape: Once Viktor W Gravity Field is down, you have a chance to hit with Mel E Solar Snare and follow up with attacks. It's easier to root and finish him after the movement speed boost and shield from Viktor Q Siphon Power have ended.
Viktor.fight: Keep your distance and build damage with Mel Q Radiant Volley. If Viktor gets close, stop his approach with Mel E Solar Snare. Viktor Q Siphon Power's shield raises the threshold for executing him, so attack just after the shield disappears.
Viktor.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, but stand to the side so Viktor E Hextech Ray doesn't hit you along with the wave. Don't use Mel E Solar Snare for poke first; save it for when Viktor closes the gap.
Viktor.phase: Reassess trades as Viktor gains more upgrades, and take advantage of Mel's power spike as she completes her core item sequence.
Viktor.teamfight: From the backline, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to build Overwhelm on several of them. Don't continue fighting inside Viktor W Gravity Field, and time Mel W Rebuttal to intercept incoming projectiles. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have Overwhelm.
Viktor.watch: Viktor E Hextech Ray travels in a straight line, so don't stand in line with the minion wave; dodge to the side. When Viktor W Gravity Field is placed, leave it immediately instead of fighting inside to avoid being stunned. You can use Mel W Rebuttal's movement speed boost to disengage, but its duration is short, so don't use it too early.
