Vladimir.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Vladimir's main damage is magic, so build magic resistance first. If his healing interferes with Mel P Searing Brilliance's execute, buy Morellonomicon. Consider Liandry's Torment against a Vladimir who builds health.
Vladimir.combo: After confirming Vladimir W Sanguine Pool has ended, root him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm remaining and the stacks are still active.
Vladimir.escape: The moment Vladimir W Sanguine Pool goes down and ends is your window to engage with Mel E Solar Snare. Don't throw an important root while the pool is still active. If Vladimir is charging E Tides of Blood and his movement is slowed, you can also close the gap and stick to him.
Vladimir.fight: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke at the same time, creating an opportunity to force out Vladimir W Sanguine Pool. After the pool ends, if Vladimir closes the gap, hit him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare to root him. The moment Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood and slows his movement is also a chance to close the gap.
Vladimir.laning: Don't use Mel E Solar Snare to farm. Save it to stop Vladimir's approach or catch him after his pool ends.
Vladimir.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds stacks and items, so get through the early game and make use of that strength.
Vladimir.teamfight: From the backline, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Spread out so multiple allies aren't hit together by Vladimir R Hemoplague, and if you're infected, step back until its effect ends. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have Overwhelm.
Vladimir.watch: Vladimir Q Transfusion heals and becomes empowered, so keep your distance when he approaches with an empowered Q. When Vladimir charges E Tides of Blood, put minions between you or get out of range. Vladimir R Hemoplague increases the damage you take, so step back until its effect ends.

Xerath.build: Buy a Null-Magic Mantle first in the early game to withstand Xerath's magic damage. Choose Mercury's Treads for boots, then continue prioritizing magic resistance.
Xerath.combo: Root him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare, then place Mel Q Radiant Volley on the rooted target. Follow up with an empowered basic attack, and finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you have enough Overwhelm.
Xerath.escape: Xerath has no mobility, so the moment Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction go down is your chance to engage. If you intercepted Xerath E Shocking Orb with Mel W Rebuttal, close the gap and look for a root with Mel E Solar Snare.
Xerath.fight: Dodge to the side while Xerath charges Q Arcanopulse and close the gap. If Xerath E Shocking Orb and Xerath W Eye of Destruction are down, look for a root with Mel E Solar Snare. You can engage while Xerath is stationary casting R Rite of the Arcane.
Xerath.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to clear the wave while poking Xerath. If you farm while dodging his heavy damage, Xerath's high mana costs will eventually leave him low on mana first. Push the lane then and call your jungler.
Xerath.phase: Survive the early game; things become more favorable for Mel as you complete your core item sequence.
Xerath.teamfight: From the very back, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Time Mel W Rebuttal for projectiles coming toward you, and if you miss that opportunity, don't step forward. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after enemies have lost health and several have Overwhelm.
Xerath.watch: Xerath Q Arcanopulse pierces minions, so when you see him charging, change direction and dodge to the side. If Xerath E Shocking Orb hits you, you'll be stunned and take follow-up attacks, so intercept it with Mel W Rebuttal as it flies toward you. When you see the cast animation for Xerath R Rite of the Arcane, start dodging immediately.

Yasuo.build: Yasuo’s main damage is physical, and Mel has low armor, so build armor first. Use Cloth Armor to survive the early game, and choose Plated Steelcaps for boots. If the enemy team has an assassin, move Zhonya’s Hourglass earlier in your build order.
Yasuo.combo: After Yasuo W Wind Wall disappears and you land the center root of Mel E Solar Snare, cast Mel Q Radiant Volley at that spot. Follow up with basic attacks to use the extra projectiles gained after casting an ability, and if you have enough Overwhelm, finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse. If Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield is active, attack just after it is removed or expires to lower the execute threshold.
Yasuo.escape: Look to trade right after Yasuo throws his Q Steel Tempest tornado, when his knock-up stacks reset. Yasuo E Sweeping Blade comes back quickly, so don’t go in deep just because he has used it once. Engage before Yasuo R Last Breath is back, when you can land the root from Mel E Solar Snare.
Yasuo.fight: Use light poke to remove Yasuo P Way of the Wanderer’s shield before trading. Stack Overwhelm with Mel Q Radiant Volley, but when Yasuo closes the gap with E Sweeping Blade, cut off his engage path with Mel E Solar Snare. If Yasuo W Wind Wall blocks your way, change your angle or save key abilities until it disappears.
Yasuo.laning: Stand behind the minion wave to increase the distance Yasuo must cover with E Sweeping Blade to reach you. Keep the wave thin on your side of the lane to reduce the number of minions Yasuo can dash through with E. Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to farm and poke, but save Mel E Solar Snare to stop his engage.
Yasuo.phase: Survive the early game and develop your item build, as this makes things more favorable for Mel. Prioritize scaling over risky early trades.
Yasuo.teamfight: Stay as far back as possible and use Mel Q Radiant Volley on clustered enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Time Mel W Rebuttal precisely against Yasuo Q Steel Tempest’s tornado, and keep your distance when he engages with E Sweeping Blade or R Last Breath instead of relying on W. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after several enemies have lost health and have Overwhelm applied.
Yasuo.watch: Yasuo Q Steel Tempest can knock you up with its narrow hitbox, so move sideways as he approaches. If he lands Q twice and has his tornado ready, watch for the sound and visual effect and dodge; time Mel W Rebuttal for when it flies toward you. Mel W Rebuttal can’t block Yasuo E Sweeping Blade or R Last Breath when he uses them to engage, so keep your distance.

Zed.build: Build Cloth Armor early to survive, then choose Plated Steelcaps. Zed's main damage is physical and Mel has low armor, so build armor first. Move Zhonya's Hourglass earlier in your core item sequence to prepare for Zed's burst.
Zed.combo: When Zed engages, hit him with the center of Mel E Solar Snare to root him.
Zed.escape: Right after Zed uses W Living Shadow, check what movement options he has left. If the shadow has disappeared or Zed has already repositioned, and Zed R Death Mark is still on cooldown, look for a root with Mel E Solar Snare and attack. If only Zed W Living Shadow is down, he can still escape with Zed R Death Mark, so don't engage too hastily.
Zed.fight: Before Zed approaches, poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley and build Overwhelm. Don't use Mel E Solar Snare for poke; save it to look for a root when Zed closes the gap. Your chance to attack comes when Zed W Living Shadow has disappeared or been used to reposition, and Zed R Death Mark is unavailable.
Zed.laning: Stand behind the minion wave to make Zed cover more distance to reach you. Save Mel E Solar Snare to respond to his engage.
Zed.phase: Survive the early game and group with your allies; Mel becomes stronger as she builds up and has the advantage later.
Zed.teamfight: From the very back, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Time Mel W Rebuttal for when Zed Q Razor Shuriken is flying toward you. If Zed engages with Zed W Living Shadow or Zed R Death Mark, use Mel E Solar Snare to interrupt his follow-up attacks. Use Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm.
Zed.watch: Send Zed Q Razor Shuriken back with Mel W Rebuttal as it flies toward you. Watch the position of Zed W Living Shadow and move outside the slow range of Zed E Shadow Slash. Zed R Death Mark dashes in, so Mel W Rebuttal can't block it; while marked, use Mel E Solar Snare to interrupt Zed's follow-up attacks.

Zoe.build: Use a Null-Magic Mantle to survive the early game, then choose Mercury's Treads for boots. Zoe's damage is mainly magic, so build magic resistance first. However, magic resistance can't reduce the true damage from Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble, so dodging the bubble comes first.
Zoe.combo: Root Zoe with the center of Mel E Solar Snare at Zoe R Portal Jump's return point or as she redirects Zoe Q Paddle Star! Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse if you've built enough Overwhelm.
Zoe.escape: If Zoe has already used R Portal Jump, look for the moment she returns to her starting point.
Zoe.fight: Poke with Mel Q Radiant Volley to build Overwhelm, and use Mel E Solar Snare when Zoe closes the gap or redirects Zoe Q Paddle Star! If Zoe R Portal Jump is down or Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble misses, look for a chance to hit Mel E Solar Snare at Zoe's return point and path. Respond to Zoe Q Paddle Star! as it flies toward you with your saved Mel W Rebuttal.
Zoe.laning: Use Mel Q Radiant Volley to clear the wave and poke at the same time, but play safely early on because of its mana cost and Mel W Rebuttal's long cooldown. Don't spend Mel E Solar Snare on farming or risky poke; save it to stop Zoe's approach. A missed Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble remains as a trap, so be careful around narrow paths without vision and bush entrances.
Zoe.phase: Mel gets stronger as she builds Overwhelm, so get through the early game; the more items she completes, the more favorable things become.
Zoe.teamfight: From the very back, use Mel Q Radiant Volley on grouped enemies to apply Overwhelm to several of them. Time Mel W Rebuttal for Zoe's incoming projectiles, and look for Mel E Solar Snare at Zoe R Portal Jump's return point. Finish with Mel R Golden Eclipse after the enemies have taken damage and several have Overwhelm.
Zoe.watch: If Zoe E Sleepy Trouble Bubble hits you, you'll fall asleep a moment later, so move behind a wall or ally in the meantime and get out of the angle and range of Zoe Q Paddle Star! When Zoe fires Q Paddle Star! and tries to redirect it, look for a root with Mel E Solar Snare. Remember where Zoe R Portal Jump starts, since she always returns there after using it.
